name: Tilden R. Selmes
role: Mandan attorney for Billings County taxpayers
bio: Tilden R. Selmes was a Mandan attorney who visited Medora in 1884 and in October 1885 attended the Cantonment sales as attorney for the estate. In March 1886 Billings County taxpayers retained him to fight Stark County's collection of taxes from them, and in April he won an injunction from Judge Francis against Stark County's treasurer. In September 1886 he was expected in Medora for a deer and antelope hunt with his stag-hounds. Through 1886 he kept the paper informed on the suit, and in December he appeared for Billings County before the court.
